message.content:
Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend** dates that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a three‑day stretch that includes a statutory holiday falling on a Friday or a Monday (or a substitute day that is moved to a Monday when the holiday falls on a weekend).

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Dates | Notes |
|---------|--------------|-------------|--------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 | Sun | Dec 30 – Jan 2 | Substitute holiday on Mon Jan 2 in most provinces. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, etc.) | Feb 20 | Mon | Feb 18 – Feb 20 | Creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 | Fri | Apr 7 – Apr 9 | Observed in all provinces except Quebec. |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 | Mon | May 20 – May 22 | Federal holiday; long weekend nationwide. |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 | Sat | Jul 1 – Jul 3 | Substitute holiday on Mon Jul 3 in most provinces. |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 | Mon | Sep 2 – Sep 4 | Federal holiday; long weekend nationwide. |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 | Mon | Oct 7 – Oct 9 | Federal holiday; long weekend nationwide. |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 | Thu | Nov 11 – Nov 13 | Substitute holiday on Mon Nov 13 in several provinces. |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 | Mon | Dec 23 – Dec 25 | Federal holiday; long weekend nationwide. |
| **St. Patrick’s Day** (Newfoundland & Labrador) | Mar 17 | Thu | Mar 15 – Mar 17 | Provincial holiday; long weekend in NL. |

### How to Use This List

* **Filter by Province** – If your app needs province‑specific data, filter the table by the “Notes” column to see which holidays apply to each region.
* **Add Substitute Days** – For holidays that fall on a weekend, add the corresponding substitute day (e.g., Jan 2, Jul 3, Nov 13) to ensure users see the full long‑weekend period.
* **Calendar Integration** – Import the dates above into your calendar system (iCal, Google Calendar, etc.) to automatically flag long weekends for users.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the data in a different format (CSV, JSON, iCal) or if you need additional details such as province‑by‑province holiday calendars.
